subject: Cygnus Health MAP kickoff — starter GDoc & slide seed
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@cygnushealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <mruiz@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cygnus Health MAP kickoff — starter GDoc & slide seed

Hi Elena / Marco,

Great speaking yesterday — per our convo I pulled together a lightweight MAP (mutual action plan) starter doc and a companion one-slide eval plan to help align stakeholders and speed the procurement path. Links/attachments below.

What I shared:
- CYG MAP starter (Google Doc) — editable: high-level milestones, owners, acceptance criteria, and a short tech checklist.
- Eval slides (1-2 slides) — sample scenarios and basic metric targets for the pilot.
- Draft SOW (stub) — outlines pilot scope, duration, and estimated committed capacity.

Primary asks / proposed next steps:
1) Please co-edit the MAP doc with any stakeholder names/titles we should add (security, procurement, BizOps).
2) Confirm target go/no-go date for procurement. If procurement can sign by Sep 20 we can start a 30-day pilot week of Sep 27—Oct 25.
3) Can we schedule a 45-minute MAP alignment workshop next week to finalize owners and acceptance criteria? I proposed Wed Sep 9 10:00–10:45 PDT and Thu Sep 10 13:00–13:45 PDT — let me know what works.

Initial acceptance criteria (draft):
- Functional: system returns >= 90% of top-3 relevant answers in sample dataset (per their eval set)
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 300ms for typical prompt mix
- Security: VPC/private deployment option validated for PHI handling in pilot

Attachments (stubs): CYG-MAP-starter-gdoc-link.txt, Cygnus-eval-slides-v0.pptx, SOW-draft-CYG-4721.pdf

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Cygnus-MAP-starter (edit access granted to elena.costa@cygnushealth.com)

I cc'd Marissa (CS) to own onboarding logistics and Jasmine (solutions) to draft the evaluation scenarios once we agree on the metrics.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0147

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@cygnushealth.com>

Subject: Re: Cygnus Health MAP kickoff — starter GDoc & slide seed

Thanks Jordan — this is exactly what I hoped for. Quick notes: 

- I'll share the MAP with our procurement lead and legal. Please cc procurement@cygnushealth.com on any contractual docs.
- Can you confirm what security artifacts you can provide for our procurement review (SOC 2 type II report, data retention policy, encryption at rest docs)? Our procurement team wants to see those before starting SOW negotiations.
- Timeline: procurement aims to complete vendor review by Sep 20 if we provide required artifacts this week. If that holds, we like the Sep 27 pilot start.

Also: a quick ask from our product team — can you add an example eval prompt set placeholder in the MAP doc so we can discuss it in the workshop?

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Cygnus Health MAP kickoff — starter GDoc & slide seed

Elena — thanks, noted. Short answers and next steps below.

Security artifacts: we can provide SOC 2 Type II summary report, our data retention whitepaper, and an encryption at-rest/key management overview. Soojin (cc'd) will drop the links in the MAP doc and add a short security checklist for procurement to review.

Eval prompt set: Jasmine will seed a short set of 10 sample prompts / expected outputs into the MAP doc before the workshop. That will give your product team something concrete to react to.

Updated timeline & commitments: 
- Today: add security artifact links + seed eval prompt set (we'll update the GDoc directly).
- Sep 7: internal review at Cygnus (you said procurement will triage).
- Sep 15–17: MAP alignment workshop window (we can do multiple short sessions if needed).
- Sep 20: target procurement sign-off (if artifacts accepted).
- Sep 27: pilot kick-off (30-day pilot).

Prelim cost estimate for pilot (ballpark): $6,500–9,000 for the 30-day pilot depending on token volume and optional dedicated capacity. We will firm this up after we get typical prompt lengths / expected concurrent load.

I've attached an updated MAP stub (I updated owners and added the security checklist): CYG-MAP-starter-gdoc-link.txt (shows doc id), SOW-draft-CYG-4721.pdf. Jasmine will add the eval slides shortly.

If Sep 15–17 is tight, we can run a single 45-minute working session on Sep 10 — please advise preference and I'll book.

—Jordan
